about_the_game:
The K-7 Facility Awaits

Sibir is a first-person survival horror exploration game set deep within the claustrophobic depths of an abandoned Soviet-era bunker. Sent to investigate the facility after the collapse of the state, you quickly discover that the government didn't just abandon this place they sealed it in.

The bunker is far from empty. In the crushing dark, everyday objects shift and contort into violent anomalies. Your primary goal is to complete your government-issued directives and scavenge what you can. Your real objective is simply to survive.

Every step you take in the dark could be your last.

Key Features

  • Navigate a twisting, procedurally generated maze of industrial corridors where the environment itself is your enemy. Paranoia is your only defense against anomalous entities that shape-shift into mundane furniture, hiding in plain sight before they strike.

  • Manage your health, hunger, and dwindling sanity as you press deeper into the freezing, unforgiving depths of the facility. The cold can be just as deadly as the things hunting you.

  • Strip the abandoned complex for parts. Utilize scrap and electronics found in the environment through an active real-time crafting system to build essential survival tools and medical supplies.

  • The bunker is too dangerous to face alone. Team up with other workers in online cooperative multiplayer, utilizing proximity voice chat to coordinate your survival or hear your friends get dragged into the dark.

  • Endure severe environmental hazards. Monitor the dropping indoor temperature, avoid pockets of toxic smoke, and watch your step around forgotten military landmines left behind by the old regime.

Will the anomalies consume you, or will you uncover the historical secrets buried within the K-7 facility?

The descent begins now.
